Description: Bounded cloud-security-lab demo: one unattached security group in an operator-selected VPC.

Metadata.SafetyBoundary: Only one unattached security group is created. No VPC, compute, ENI, subnet, route, gateway, endpoint, load balancer, public IP, IAM identity, S3 object, or secret is created.

VpcId.Description: Existing authorized VPC in which to create the disposable unattached group.

Properties.GroupDescription: Unattached group for bounded public-SSH rule analysis

SecurityGroupIngress.Description: Intentional static analyzer input; no workload is attached

SecurityGroupId.Description: Unattached group expected to produce NET-001.
